data.name: Alchemist
targeting_extra: Camo priority not listed on wiki
Shrink potion always Strong, infinite range
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Larger Potions
1.text: Main potion +5 pierce, splash radius +7 (+50%). Crosspath: Acid Pool +5 pierce; Rubber to Gold gold potion +5 pierce and +10.5 radius; Unstable Concoction +1 pierce, +7 radius; Transforming Tonic/Total Transformation eye beam +3 pierce. No effect on shrink potion.

1.name: Acidic Mixture Dip
1.text: Second attack: potion thrown every 10s at a random eligible tower in radius (prefers unbuffed). Buff: pops Lead, +1 damage to Ceramic / MOAB-class / Fortified Lead (mutually exclusive); lasts 10 attacks, stackable to 30.

1.name: Berserker Brew
1.text: Throws brew to closest tower in range: +1 damage, +2 pierce, +10% range, -10% cooldown (~11.11% attack speed); lasts 25 shots or 5s (40 shots/6s with 3-2-0), whichever shorter. Brew thrown every 8s (6.4s with Faster Throwing); target cannot be rebuffed for 5s (4s with 3-2-0).

1.name: Stronger Stimulant
1.text: Improved brew: +1 dmg, +3 pierce, +15% range, -15% cooldown (~17.6% atk speed); 40 shots or 12s (55/13s with 4-2-0). Does not stack with Berserker Brew or Permanent Brew.

1.name: Permanent Brew
1.text: New Acidic Mixture Dip and Stronger Stimulant buffs last permanently (until Alchemist is sold/sacrificed or buff stolen by Lych). Targets with a weaker brew get it only after it runs out.

2.name: Stronger Acid
2.text: DoT tick 2s->1.5s, duration 4s->4.5s; also applies to Acid Pool.

2.name: Perishing Potions
2.text: Main potions and Acid Pools +4 MOAB-class damage and +15 Fortified MOAB-class (20 total); strips Fortified from non-MOAB bloons. Crosspath: Dip buff lasts 12 attacks; Berserker/Stimulant +1s or +15 attacks and -1s reapply cooldown.

2.name: Unstable Concoction
2.text: MOAB-class-only concoction, no damage, marks target; when its outer layer is popped it explodes (pierce 50, damages any type except Camo unless Alchemist had camo detection; not the children). Explosion damage depends on max unmodified health of the marked layer (incl. Fortified). Range 67.5 (150% of tower).

2.name: Transforming Tonic
2.text: Ability: Alchemist becomes monster for 20s (24s with Strong Tonic MK), loses regular attacks, fires eye beam 3 dmg, pierce 6, range 72, cd 0.03s. Ability cd 60s, initial 20s.

2.name: Total Transformation
2.text: Ability also transforms the 5 closest eligible towers into mini laser monsters for 20s (they don't inherit most upgrades, keep most buffs, no crosspath benefits). Cooldown 60->40s. Cannot be used while already transformed.

3.name: Faster Throwing
3.text: All attack cooldowns -20% (+25% attack speed). Main potion every 1.6s.

3.name: Acid Pool
3.text: With no targets, main attack drops acid pool randomly on track in range; every 5th potion that targets a bloon drops a pool if its splash pierce was not used up. Pool 1 dmg, pierce 5, 6.95s, any type except Glass, no innate Camo, can't hit same bloon twice, applies main potion DoT.

3.name: Lead to Gold
3.text: All attacks and acid +9 Lead damage (kills Lead and Fortified Lead in one shot); popping a Lead bloon with them gives $50 on top of normal pop income (bonus not affected by external buffs, affected by Double Cash).

3.name: Rubber to Gold
3.text: Separate non-damaging gold potion attack: affected bloons (not BAD/Boss) give +100% pop income (additive with Monkey Town, Bloon Trap, Pirate Lord) and lose Lead/Black/Purple/White immunity for 14s; soaks through non-MOAB layers.

3.name: Bloon Master Alchemist
3.text: Shrink potion converts affected bloons to Red; always Strong, infinite range, pierce 200, cd 10s. Cannot affect BADs/Bosses/Test bloons. Needs support to affect Camo. Grants no cash for shrunk bloons.
